title: Tape 2 side B: trying to sort the chronology after Hollywood
summary: Bubbles loses the thread of the questions; Nierenberg recaps that at about 21 he had done Pathe films and returned to New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I was wondering what happened. We went to Oliver, that's what I was talking about. We passed that, now, went to Riverside, where I grew up in Riverside. Burns and Allen, where do you go from there, I thought was going to be another question. But it wasn't, I was just going to feel my way and I might as well go into Germany and start doing special shows then that way. If we can't go do chronological as we're going. And I'm trying to find out what to follow them with, what we talked about before, you said that you asked me about the colored acts on the same bill, didn't you, and I brought that out and when I told you about the places I played with Bing Crosby, Frank Sinatra at the Paramount and Bing Crosby at the Paramount and the Globe with Tony DiMarco and Sallie -- now we're we going from that Riverside Theater --
How old were you then, about this time, so I get the context

You'd already been to Hollywood, you'd done some Pathe' films, right? You'd been with Nat Nazarro for two years now with Buck. You were both traveling together and you're back in New York after Hollywood. After Hollywood did you go directly back to New York?
Yeh, that's where all the theatrical profession is, in New York.
You weren't tap dancing at this point, or were you?
